description:
External alterations to the ground floor side and rear elevations, comprising: demolition of the existing single storey lean-to; construction of a new thermally insulated rendered wall; installation of polyester powder-coated double-glazed aluminium sliding folding doors to the rear, and a door and openable windows to the north-east side elevation; installation of openable rooflights to the existing flat roof; erection of a cycle store and a bin store in the rear yard; removal of the existing kitchen extract flue; installation of ventilation grilles; making good
of render and brick coping; and repair of the decorative tiled shopfront pilasters.
decision_conditions:
-Correct red line. The red line needs to include all the land for the development. In this case for example the side access and propsoed bin store. Include the land in the blue line within the red line.
-A Certificate B is required for all owners of land within the red line. The cert must serve  notice on 19A above. 
-FRA - The site is in a ground water policy zone. Can be proportionate to the scale of the development. 
-Confirm no mechanical ventilation re: proposed ventilation grilles. 
-Fire safety statement
